`python.json` contains synthetic compatibility vectors captured before the Python implementation was removed.

`ride.fit` is a synthetic activity encoded with Garmin FIT SDK 21.221.0. It contains six one-second records, each with 200 W, 80 rpm, 120 bpm, 10 m/s, 100 m altitude and coordinates (0, 0). Distance increases from 0 to 50 m in 10 m steps. FIT timestamps run from 1000 through 1005; the activity ends at 1006. It contains no rider data.
